about.title: About the ME Black Star Promos
paragraphs: The ME Black Star Promos are the 112 numbered promo cards of the Mega Evolution era, from collection boxes, tins, blisters, Elite Trainer Boxes and events.

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
